profile.headline: Python/Big Data/Web Developer
profile.summary: Graduate from UTSA with a Bachelors degree in Computer Science. My general focuses are in web/app/game development, big data, and business analytics.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician and I.T.
positions.description:
• Responsible for scheduling and performing laboratory tasks while maintaining an organized, clean and safe workspace.
• Responsible for various I.T. related tasks such as installation of various operating systems, hardware consisting of printers, routers, networking cables, etc., and offer technical assistance and troubleshooting to various employees.
• Perform concrete compression tests in accordance to ASTM C-39 using a Forney FX250 hydraulic press.
• Perform soil tests such as: D698 Proctor, D4318 Plasticity Index, D1140 Sieve Analysis

positions.title: Vehicle Service Agent
positions.description:
• Responsible and accountable for thorough vehicle detailing and vehicle maintenance.
• Responsible for customer transportation as needed. Must provide exceptional customer service and meet all service standards.
• Detail an average of 100 vehicles per day with an overall branch return list of 800+ vehicles.
